name: kotlin-continuous-intellisense
description: Triggers Kotlin completion while an identifier is still being typed.

commands.title: Kotlin: Warm Up Continuous IntelliSense Now

kotlinContinuousIntelliSense.enabled.description: Trigger Kotlin suggestions while an identifier is being typed.

kotlinContinuousIntelliSense.minimumPref.description: Identifier length at which continuous suggestions start.

kotlinContinuousIntelliSense.triggerInte.description: Minimum interval between leading-edge suggestion triggers. This is not an idle debounce.

kotlinContinuousIntelliSense.warmupEnabl.description: Warm the Kotlin completion engine in the background when a Kotlin editor becomes active.

kotlinContinuousIntelliSense.warmupDelay.description: Delay before the one-time background completion warmup.
